earnings.title: Valero Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Reported net income attributable to Valero stockholders of $6.8 billion, or $23.89 per share
Reported adjusted net income attributable to Valero stockholders of $6.8 billion, or $23.90 per share

SAN ANTONIO, October 22, 2026 – Valero Energy Corporation (NYSE: VLO, “Valero”) today reported net income attributable to Valero stockholders of $6.8 billion, or $23.89 per share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.1 billion, or $3.53 per share, for the third quarter of 2025.

Excluding the adjustments shown in the accompanying earnings release tables, adjusted net income attributable to Valero stockholders for the third quarter of 2026 was $6.8 billion, or $23.90 per share, compared to $1.1 billion, or $3.66 per share, for the third quarter of 2025.
The Refining segment reported operating income of $8.8 billion for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.6 billion for the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Our refineries operated at near-record utilization rates, providing a reliable supply of critical transportation fuels during the quarter.
quotes.by: Lane Riggs, Valero’s Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President

quotes.text: Our third-quarter performance underscores the quality of our assets and our consistent operational, commercial, and financial performance.

items.heading: Our financial results are affected by volatile margins, which are dependent upon factors beyond our control, including the prices we pay to acquire feedstocks and the market prices at which we can sell our products.
We are subject to risks arising from the Renewable and Low-Carbon Fuel Programs, and other regulations, policies, international certifications, and standards impacting low-carbon fuels.
We are subject to risks arising from the availability and prices of natural gas, electricity, and water.
The availability and prices of our feedstocks and other critical supplies expose us to risks.
We are subject to risks arising from our operations and business activities outside of the U.S.
We are subject to risks arising from transportation and logistics disruptions and availability.
